nodes.long_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded es un clásico juego de disparos contra zombis en VR. Incluye una campaña completa que puedes jugar a solas o en cooperativo de 2 jugadores, un modo Horda para 1 a 4 jugadores, realidad mixta y una variedad de desafíos adicionales.

{1799401827572683}

El laboratorio de investigación Horizon ha quedado en silencio. Sus antiguos habitantes ahora son muertos vivientes, y algo siniestro espera detrás de cada puerta. Apunta con cuidado, elige tus armas y ábrete paso en medio del brote zombi.

Sé el héroe de tu propia historia de supervivencia. Avanza por el laboratorio, enfréntate a enemigos aterradores y aprovecha todo lo que encuentres para seguir con vida.

{590717150629386}

*CARACTERÍSTICAS* 

* Juego con modo de campaña de tamaño completo. 
* Juego cooperativo multijugador para 2 jugadores. 
* Modo de juego de realidad mixta para dispositivos Quest 2 y Quest 3, 3S. 
* Mejorado para Meta Quest 3, 3S.

{582448788090049}

* 8 desafíos: modos de juego adicionales para juegos en solitario o cooperativos. * Varias armas de fuego y armas cuerpo a cuerpo. 
* ¡Juego con más de 3 años de actualizaciones, asistencia y mejoras gratuitas continuas!

Para sobrevivir y salvar al mundo del virus, tendrás que usar ambas manos y la cabeza: nunca dejes de disparar, recoge munición, sube por las tuberías y las escaleras, salta a las rejas y sujétate de las cuerdas, registra los armarios y arrójales todo lo que encuentres a los zombis.

Los habitantes de la estación Horizon te castigarán por una cosa: dudar...

{1876600943149819}
nodes.short_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded es un clásico juego de disparos contra zombis en VR con una campaña completa para jugar a solas o en cooperativo de 2 jugadores, modo Horda para 1 a 4 jugadores, realidad mixta y desafíos adicionales.

El laboratorio Horizon ha quedado en silencio. Sus antiguos habitantes ahora son muertos vivientes y el mal acecha tras cada puerta. Apunta bien, elige tus armas y ábrete paso entre los zombis.

Sé el héroe de tu propia historia de supervivencia.

nodes.display_name: 데스 호라이즌: 리로드 | Death Horizon: Reloaded
nodes.long_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded는 클래식 VR 좀비 슈팅 게임입니다. 혼자 또는 2인 협동으로 즐길 수 있는 완전한 캠페인과 1~4인 호드 모드, 혼합 현실, 다양한 추가 도전 과제를 제공합니다.

{1815034325959132}

호라이즌 연구소에 적막이 내려앉았습니다. 한때 이곳에 있던 사람들은 이제 걸어 다니는 시체가 되었고, 문 너머마다 사악한 무언가가 기다리고 있습니다. 신중하게 조준하고 무기를 선택해 좀비 사태를 뚫고 나가세요.

나만의 생존 이야기에서 영웅이 되어 보세요. 연구소를 헤쳐 나가며 무시무시한 적과 싸우고, 손에 넣을 수 있는 모든 것을 활용해 살아남으세요.

{649323567607680}

**게임 특징**

* 완전한 캠페인 게임 모드
* 2인 멀티플레이어 협동 게임
* Meta Quest 2 및 Meta Quest 3, 3S 기기용 혼합 현실 게임 모드
* Meta Quest 3, 3S 에서 향상된 성능
* 8가지 도전 - 1인 또는 협동 게임용 추가 게임 모드
* 다양한 총기 및 근접 무기
* 3년 이상 지속적인 무료 업데이트, 지원, 개선 사항 제공

연구소의 스테이지를 모두 완료하고, 수많은 괴물의 무리를 쓰러뜨리세요. 미국의 가장 좋은 무기들을 마음껏 사용하세요. 데스 이글? 산탄총? 죽은자들을 무찌를 가장 좋은 방법을 골라보세요.

{1138961914380635}

살아남아서 바이러스로부터 세상을 구해내려면, 양손과 머리를 전부 활용해야 합니다. 쉴 틈 없이 사격하며 탄약을 주워들고, 파이프와 사다리를 올라가고, 지지대 위로 점프하고, 로프에 매달리고, 벽장을 뒤지고, 당신이 가진 모든 것을 사용해 좀비들과 싸우세요.

원하는 무기와 전술을 자유롭게 선택할 수도 있답니다. 자신의 민첩성, 상상력, 그리고 사격 실력을 증명하세요.

당신이 망설이는 순간, 호라이즌 스테이션에 존재하는 괴물들은 더욱 가혹하게 공격해올 겁니다...

{1309413833609436}

* 좀비 대재앙을 다룬 영화의 스타일에 따라 사실적이고 유혈이 낭자한 그래픽.
*  완전한 액션: 사격, 총기, 탄약, 사방의 적, 유혈.
*  자유로운 이동: 주위 환경을 최대한 활용하여 살아남으세요.
*  모든 선택은 당신의 몫입니다: 원하는 방식으로 게임을 플레이하세요.
*  두 개의 컨트롤러를 능동적으로 활용하세요: 양손으로 사격하거나, 밧줄에 매달린 상태로 사격하거나, 다른 손으로 산탄총을 재장전하거나, 파이프를 따라 올라가며 스테이션 내부에 숨겨진 장소를 탐험하세요.

nodes.display_name: 死亡地平线：重装上阵 | Death Horizon: Reloaded
nodes.long_description:
《Death Horizon: Reloaded》是一款经典的VR僵尸射击游戏，拥有可单人或双人合作游玩的完整战役、支持1至4人的尸潮模式、混合现实玩法，以及丰富的额外挑战。

Horizon研究实验室陷入了死寂。昔日的工作人员已沦为行尸走肉，每扇门后都潜伏着邪恶的东西。仔细瞄准，挑选武器，在僵尸爆发的危机中杀出一条生路。

{994792915915095}

成为自己生存故事中的英雄。深入实验室，与可怕的敌人战斗，利用找到的一切努力活下去。

{666952915800917}

*游戏特色* 

* 完整的战役游戏模式
* 支持 2 名玩家的多人合作游戏模式
* 支持 Meta Quest 2 和 Meta Quest 3, 3S 设备的混合现实游戏模式
* 为 Meta Quest 3, 3S 进行了增强
* 8 个挑战——适用于单人或合作游戏的额外游戏模式
* 各种枪械和近战武器
* 游戏在 3 年来持续不断地免费更新、提供支持和进行改进！

你需要完成所有实验室关卡并消灭成群的怪物。拥有美国尖端武器，你将选择如何与尸群战斗——无论你决定使用沙鹰还是猎枪！

{1179593327008099}

 
为了生存，并拯救世界免受病毒感染，你得用上你的双手和聪明才智：永远不要停止射击，记得随时捡子弹，攀爬水管和梯子，跳上栏杆，抓住绳子，搜索橱柜，把你找到的所有东西都朝僵尸扔过去。
 
你可以自由选择武器和战术，向世界证明你的敏捷身手、想象力和无敌枪法。
 
不要犹豫，否则你将会被地平线站点的“居民”残酷惩罚。

●逼真的血腥画面，宛如僵尸启示录电影。

●全套要素：射击、枪、子弹、敌人和鲜血。

{1780585272792910}


●高自由度：利用周围环境生存。

●一切由你决定：按你的意愿进行游戏。

●专为Meta Quest 开发。

●积极运用双手手柄：双手开火，悬挂在绳子上开火，用另一只手给霰弹枪装弹，抓住管道移动，探索难以到达的区域。

nodes.long_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded ist ein klassischer VR-Zombie-Shooter mit einer vollständigen Kampagne, die du allein oder im Zweispieler-Koop spielen kannst. Dazu kommen ein Horde-Modus für 1 bis 4 Spieler, Mixed Reality und zahlreiche weitere Herausforderungen.

{1177066051094823}

Im Horizon-Forschungslabor ist es still geworden. Seine früheren Bewohner gehören jetzt zu den wandelnden Toten, und hinter jeder Tür wartet etwas Böses. Ziele genau, wähle deine Waffen und kämpfe dich durch den Zombie-Ausbruch.

Werde zum Helden deiner eigenen Überlebensgeschichte. Arbeite dich durch das Labor, bekämpfe furchteinflößende Gegner und nutze alles, was du finden kannst, um am Leben zu bleiben.

{1334125737913751}

**FEATURES**

* Kampagnenmodus in voller Größe
* Kooperatives Multiplayer-Spiel für 2 Spieler
* Mixed Reality Spielmodus für Quest 2 und Quest 3, 3S Geräte
* Optimiert für Meta Quest 3, 3S
* 8 Herausforderungen - zusätzliche Spielmodi für das Einzel- oder Kooperationsspiel
* Verschiedene Schuss- und Nahkampfwaffen
* Spiel mit über 3 Jahren kontinuierlicher kostenloser Updates, Support und Verbesserungen!

{1153806033205298}

Als du herkamst, warst du von Hunderten lebender Toten umgeben. Und das alles wegen dieses verdammten T12-Virus.

Um zu überleben und die Welt vor dem Virus zu retten, musst du beide Hände und deinen Kopf einsetzen: Hör nie auf zu schießen, sammle Munition ein, klettere Rohre und Leitern hoch, springe auf Stahlträger und greife nach Seilen, durchsuche Schränke und wirf alles, was du finden kannst, nach den Zombies.

{951247387121002}
nodes.short_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded ist ein klassischer VR-Zombie-Shooter mit einer Kampagne für Solo-Spieler oder 2-Spieler-Koop, einem Horde-Modus für 1–4 Spieler, Mixed Reality und weiteren Herausforderungen.

Im Horizon-Forschungslabor ist es still geworden. Seine früheren Bewohner sind jetzt Untote, und hinter jeder Tür lauert das Böse. Ziele genau, wähle deine Waffen und kämpfe dich durch den Zombie-Ausbruch.

Werde zum Helden deiner eigenen Überlebensgeschichte.

nodes.long_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded est un jeu de tir VR classique contre des zombies. Il propose une campagne complète jouable en solo ou en coopération à deux, un mode Horde pour 1 à 4 joueurs, de la réalité mixte et de nombreux défis supplémentaires.

{1321151519102252}

Le laboratoire de recherche Horizon est plongé dans le silence. Ses anciens occupants font désormais partie des morts-vivants, et quelque chose de maléfique vous attend derrière chaque porte. Visez juste, choisissez vos armes et frayez-vous un chemin à travers cette invasion de zombies.

{971872891714916}

Soyez le héros de votre propre histoire de survie. Progressez dans le laboratoire, affrontez des ennemis terrifiants et servez-vous de tout ce que vous trouverez pour rester en vie.

**CARACTÉRISTIQUES** 

* Un mode campagne grandeur nature 
* Un mode coop multijoueur pour deux joueurs 
* Un mode réalité mixte pour les Meta Quest 2 & 3, 3S
* Optimisé pour le Meta Quest 3, 3S
* Huit défis – des modes supplémentaires pour le jeu en solo ou en coop 
* Diverses armes à feu et armes de mêlée 
* Un jeu proposant de plus de trois ans de mises à jour gratuites, d'assistance et d'améliorations !

{1226048679044716}

Quand vous avez repris connaissance, il y avait des centaines de morts-vivants autour de vous à cause de ce maudit virus T12.

Tirez dans tous les sens, ramassez des munitions, grimpez aux canalisations et aux échelles, sautez sur les rambardes, agrippez-vous aux cordes, fouillez les placards et jetez tout ce que vous trouvez sur les zombies.

{2296250660768700}
nodes.short_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded est un jeu de tir VR classique contre des zombies, avec une campagne jouable en solo ou en coop à deux, un mode Horde pour 1 à 4 joueurs, de la réalité mixte et d'autres défis.

Le laboratoire Horizon est plongé dans le silence. Ses anciens occupants sont devenus des morts-vivants, et le mal rôde derrière chaque porte. Visez juste, choisissez vos armes et frayez-vous un chemin à travers l'épidémie.

Soyez le héros de votre propre histoire de survie.

Death Horizon: Reloaded — классический VR-шутер про зомби с полноценной кампанией для одиночной игры или кооператива на двоих, режимом «Орда» для 1–4 игроков, смешанной реальностью и дополнительными испытаниями.

В исследовательской лаборатории Horizon воцарилась тишина. Её бывшие обитатели стали ходячими мертвецами, а за каждой дверью таится зло. Цельтесь точнее, выбирайте оружие и пробивайтесь сквозь толпы зомби.

Станьте героем собственной истории выживания.

nodes.display_name: デスホライズン: リーロード | Death Horizon: Reloaded
nodes.long_description:
Death Horizon: Reloadedは、王道のVRゾンビシューター。ソロまたは2人協力プレイで楽しめる本格的なキャンペーンに加え、1～4人用のホードモード、複合現実（MR）、さまざまな追加チャレンジを収録しています。

{1335730521100800}

ホライゾン研究所は静まり返っています。かつてそこにいた人々は歩く死者と化し、どの扉の向こうにも邪悪な何かが待ち受けています。狙いを定め、武器を選び、ゾンビの大発生を生き延びるために戦い抜きましょう。

自分だけのサバイバルストーリーの主人公になろう。研究所を進み、恐ろしい敵と戦い、見つけたものを何でも活用して生き残りましょう。

{1377510283668316}

**ゲームの特長**

* フルサイズのキャンペーンゲームモード
* 2人用のマルチプレイヤー協力プレイゲーム
* Meta Quest 2、Meta Quest 3, 3S デバイス向けの複合現実ゲームモード
* Meta Quest 3, 3S 向けに強化
* 8つのチャレンジ：ソロゲーム、協力プレイゲームで使える追加のゲームモード
* 様々な銃火器と近接戦闘用武器
* 3年以上にわたりアップデート、サポート、改良が無料で継続的に提供されます！

あなたは研究所のすべてのレベルをクリアして、モンスターの大群を倒さなければならない。DEATH EAGLEやショットガンなど、アメリカを象徴する武器を使いこなして、臨機応変にモンスターの群れと戦おう。

{1139008880879505}

生き残り、ウイルスに侵された世界を救うためには、両手と頭をフル活用しよう。撃ちまくり、弾薬を拾い、パイプや梯子を登り、バーに飛び乗り、ロープをつかみ、棚を調べ、見つけたものすべてをゾンビに投げつけよう。

ありとあらゆる武器と戦術を駆使して、敏捷性、想像力、正確性を発揮しよう。

でもひとつ注意が必要だ。ホライゾン研究所の住人は、あなたの「ためらい」を見逃すことはないだろう...

●  黙示録的なゾンビ映画のスピリットを受け継ぐリアルなバイオレンス描写

●  シューティング、ガンプレイ、弾薬補給、強敵、流血… アクションが盛りだくさん！

{1155128445995690}

● 自由な移動: 周囲の状況に上手く対応して生き残ろう

●  選択はすべてあなた次第: 自分のスタイルに合わせてプレイしよう

●  2つのコントローラーを活用: 両手で射撃、ロープにつかまった状態で射撃、空いている手でショットガンをリロード、パイプにつかまって移動困難な場所を探索、等々

Para sobrevivir y salvar al mundo del virus, tendrás que usar ambas manos y la cabeza: nunca dejes de disparar, recoge munición, sube por las tuberías y las escaleras, salta a las rejas y sujétate de las cuerdas, registra los armarios y arrójales todo lo que encuentres a los zombis.

Los habitantes de la estación Horizon te castigarán por una cosa: dudar...

{9319798704793941}
nodes.short_description:
Death Horizon: Reloaded es un clásico juego de disparos contra zombis en VR con una campaña completa para jugar a solas o en cooperativo de 2 jugadores, modo Horda para 1 a 4 jugadores, realidad mixta y desafíos adicionales.

El laboratorio Horizon ha quedado en silencio. Sus antiguos habitantes ahora son muertos vivientes y el mal acecha tras cada puerta. Apunta bien, elige tus armas y ábrete paso entre los zombis.

Sé el héroe de tu propia historia de supervivencia.

**Halloween in Death Horizon!**

Death Horizon: Reloaded is a classic VR zombie shooter with a full campaign playable solo or in 2-player co-op, 1–4 player Horde Mode, Mixed Reality, and a variety of additional challenges.

The Horizon research laboratory has gone quiet. Its former residents are now among the walking dead, and something evil waits beyond every door. Aim carefully, choose your weapons, and fight your way through the zombie outbreak.

Be the hero of your own survival story.

nodes.long_description:
The Horizon scientific research center is a deceptively quiet place. When you came round, there were hundreds of the living dead all around you. All because of that damn T12 virus. You’ll need to complete all the laboratory levels and take down crowds of zombie-monsters. You have the best of American weaponry at your disposal. Choose for yourself how to fight the horde best – with a Deagle or a Shotgun?

To survive and save the world from the virus, use both hands and your head. Never stop shooting, pick up rounds, climb up pipes and ladders, jump onto bars and grab hold of ropes, search lockers and throw everything you find at the zombies. You’re free to choose whatever weapons and tactics you want. Prove your agility, imagination and accuracy. The denizens of the Horizon station will punish you for one thing: hesitation...

Celebrate Halloween in Death Horizon!

- Added spooky seasonal decorations.
- Minor bug fixes.
- Performance improvements.

Happy Halloween!

Version 1.0 – Holiday Season event ended

The holiday season in Death Horizon: Reloaded has come to an end.

Seasonal winter decorations and festive visual elements have been removed, returning the game to its original dark and intense atmosphere.

Thank you for playing with us during the holidays — invite your friends and keep surviving together in Co-op and Horde Mode!

---
Version 1.0 - Holiday Season Update.

Celebrate the winter holiday season with us! 

We’ve updated Death Horizon: Reloaded with festive, winter-themed visual improvements and seasonal decorations to bring a cozy and joyful atmosphere to your gameplay experience. 

Invite your friends to join you in Co-op or Horde Mode, spend time together, and share the fun this holiday season!

---
What’s New:

🎃 Halloween theme has been disabled — the game has returned to its classic atmosphere

🛠 Various bug fixes and stability improvements

⚙️ General performance optimizations

🚀 We’re preparing exciting new updates — stay tuned!

---

🎃 Halloween Update is here! 

Horizon Lab is now covered in spooky Halloween decorations — glowing pumpkins, eerie lights, and mysterious shadows lurking around every corner.

Step into the nightmare and face the undead in style — if you dare! 💀

Happy haunting, survivors!

----

Version 1.0.0 – Horde Mode Update

Horde Mode is here! Face endless waves of zombies alone or team up with up to 4 players in this brand-new co-op survival challenge. The longer you last, the tougher the horde becomes!

What's new in this update?

- New Horde Mode – an additional game mode where you must survive relentless waves of undead.
- Solo or Co-op (1-4 players) – fight alone or call your friends; teamwork makes survival easier... and way more fun!
- Expanded arsenal – wield a variety of firearms and melee weapons to adapt and survive.

🔥 This update is completely FREE for all existing players!

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, please let us know at info@dream-dev.com.

Thank you!

----

Version 0.9.6.2, code 190

- Fixed an issue where the MR game mode would get stuck on an endless 'Loading' screen. 

We apologize for the inconvenience caused with Mixed Reality Mode. 

The MR game mode should now function correctly.

If you encounter any issues, please let us know at info@dream-dev.com. 

Thank you!

---

Version 0.9.6.2

- The Holiday-themed decorations have been removed. The Horizon station's interior has returned to its classic appearance.

- Coming soon: Horde Mode – a brand-new game mode where you can play solo or team up with up to 4 players. Stay tuned for updates!

----

Version 0.9.6.1

Celebrate the Holidays with Death Horizon: Reloaded’s Christmas Update!

The zombie apocalypse just got a festive twist! Explore chilling new levels adorned with glowing holiday lights, festive decor, and snowy surprises. Battle the undead in a world where the holidays meet survival horror.

Dive into the holiday chaos and make this season unforgettable in Death Horizon: Reloaded! 

-----

Version 0.9.6:

ENHANCED FOR META QUEST 3 & 3S UPDATE: Dive into New Visuals, Immersive Shadows, and the Flamethrower!

In this update:

- Dynamic shadows for enemies
- Texture improvements
- Enhanced lighting
- Dynamic lighting introduced in certain game level areas
- Flamethrower added

If you encounter any bugs in the game or have suggestions for improvements, please feel free to contact us at info@dream-dev.com.

---

Version 0.9.5.6

- Halloween Update

---

Version 0.9.5.5

Added two new cheats to "Experimental" Mode:

* Big Jump (player can jump very high)
* One Punch (defeat enemies with one hit)

Additionally, the "Infinite Ammo" cheat now includes unbreakable melee weapons, including the Chainsaw.

The experimental game mode is a paid feature and costs $4.99 (unlocked with in-app purchase).

If you have any questions or suggestions, please let us know at info@dream-dev.com.

Thank you very much!

----

Version 0.9.5.4

In this update, we've introduced a new "Experimental" game mode.

In the Experimental game mode, players have the ability to use cheats and begin the game from any checkpoint.

This game mode is not connected to your game progress or leaderboards.

Currently available cheats include "God Mode," "All Weapons," and "Infinite Ammo."

If you enjoy the idea, we will consider adding additional cheats to the game.

The experimental game mode is a paid feature and costs $4.99 (unlocked with in-app purchase).

If you have any questions or suggestions, please let us know at info@dream-dev.com.

Thank you very much!

----

Version 0.9.5.2

- Moved the game to a new version of the engine to ensure longer support.

- Fixed a bug where some items could disappear below the floor level.

If you encounter any bugs in the game or have suggestions for improvements, please feel free to contact us at info@dream-dev.com.

Thank you!

Regards,
Dream Dev Studio.

-----

Version 0.9.5.1

Update for the MR game mode:

1. Fixed some bugs and made improvements to the MR game mode.

2. We made some adjustments to the game difficulty in the MR game mode.

BEGINNER is now significantly easier.
ADVANCED is slightly easier.
EXPERT difficulty without changes.

Please share your feedback on the new game mode with us at info@dream-dev.com.

Thank you!

---

Version 0.9.5

BIG UPDATE with Mixed Reality (MR) mode for all Meta Quest 2 & 3 owners! 

We've introduced an exciting new game mode. As always, it's free for existing players.

Please share your feedback on the new game mode with us at info@dream-dev.com.

Thank you!
----

Version 0.9.47

The Christmas party is over.

The new update featuring Mixed Reality is on its way and will be available soon.

---

Version 0.9.46

Holiday Update! Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2024!

The new Christmas update is available for download!

In this update:

- Horizon Lab Station made a lot of preparations for Christmas in Campaign + co-op + Challenges modes.

- For Meta Quest 2 owners, new edged and bladed weapons, as well as a chainsaw, have been added (Meta Quest 3 owners already have these).

If you have any ideas for game improvement, visit: https://deathhorizon.horizonlab.info/

Thank you!

-----

Version 0.9.45

Halloween's party is over.

The Horizon Lab station is back to its normal state, eagerly anticipating Christmas.

Happy Halloween! Get spooked and have fun!

Halloween is celebrated at the Horizon Laboratory.

Just for several weeks, all rooms of the station will be looking in a different way.

Join the party, our zombies are waiting for you.
